name: Silver Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts. Many people fill the street here, undoubtedly
desc3: heading to or from the town square. The back end of a long brick
desc4: building is to the north, and to the south you can see the side of a
desc5: tall wooden one. A warm glow streams out through one of its windows,
desc6: and you can see people clustered around tables. It is apparently some
desc7: sort of Inn. Silver street continues off to the east and west.
